context: Hina sees Mei's new baby for the first time.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、新しい家族、可愛い！
lines.en: Grandma, the new family is so cute!
lines.style: Bright, unfiltered excitement. Quick opening attack on the exclamation. High register, childish breathiness. Genuine warmth—not performed. Slight rise on 'cute' as if asking for confirmation from someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ね、優しく、抱っこ、しようね。
lines.style: Warm, patient instruction. Soft opening, almost singing the words. Deliberate pace with a tiny pause after the dash, as if demonstrating gentleness through her own delivery. Steady, reassuring grandmother voice.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Determined, careful promise. Voice focused downward, as if concentrating on her own hands. Quiet sincerity. The thoughtfulness of a child taking responsibility seriously. Small, genuine.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.en: Our family grew again, didn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, almost musing. Warm exhale on the opening. Slow, gentle pace. A light rise at the end—not a question seeking answer, but an observation shared with someone beside her. The weight of quiet joy.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I can't wait to play with them!
lines.style: Buoyant, forward-looking. Energy returns after the quieter moment. Quick pace, eager. The natural rise of a child projecting forward into the future. Genuine, unguarded delight.
